title: Enablement Kit — Identity Modernization with Entra
author_notes: Enablement Kit (self-guided training). Lab scripts + KQL; read-only/preview-first. PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph / Az) + KQL. Cross-references existing Entra solutions (ENTPIM/ENTPASSKEY/ENTZTCA/ENTIGA, Conditional Access Integration, Hybrid Identity, SAML App Factory, enterprise-app governance) rather than duplicating them (gap-only). Change scripts -WhatIf/report-only-first + break-glass; licensing (P1/P2/Governance/GSA/Verified ID) + preview flagged verify.
